recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is recommended for FHIR-7177 unless a future OO work group decision changes NutritionOrder nutrient modeling or asks for examples beyond the accepted parenthetical clarification.
issue_request: FHIR-7177 was a Published FHIR-core OO change request with Persuasive with Modification resolution asking how NutritionOrder.oralDiet.nutrient would be used; the accepted clarification was to add a parenthetical example list such as carbohydrate, fiber, or sodium.
initial_application: Historical commit 534862556cd06a263b3e746ace9c828669fd04da, titled [#7177],[#7173], added the carbohydrate/fiber/sodium parenthetical to the old NutritionOrder spreadsheet definition. Later source migration moved the resource definition into structuredefinition-NutritionOrder.xml, and the 2024 NutritionOrder revision preserved the parenthetical examples while rephrasing the sentence.
additional_context: The current build uses NutritionOrder, not NutritionRequest: source/fhir.ini actively lists nutritionorder=NutritionOrder and lists NutritionRequest only under removed resources. FHIR-11092 and commit bc0b5b5ebe7774e25d724e29b882f1f43e7c341f explain that a temporary NutritionRequest rename was reversed back to NutritionOrder. Bounded Zulip and Confluence searches found no later conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The authoritative active source at source/nutritionorder/structuredefinition-NutritionOrder.xml defines NutritionOrder.oralDiet.nutrient as defining the quantity and nutrient modified, with examples carbohydrate, fiber, or sodium, so the FHIR-7177 clarification is already present.
